contract: A PROVEN_IRRELEVANT rule removes only the one item blocker it names, and only when every operand of its predicate is authoritative for this request. The H&S Battle/Calc damage contract is the single-hit damage range and its percentage of the defender's max HP for the current observed state; the shipped H&S engine emits no KO/survival text (calculateHnsDamage returns koChanceText ""). Missing operands return UNKNOWN, which never clears. Effect suppression (Klutz, Embargo, Magic Room) only removes a hold effect, so every irrelevance proof below also holds under suppression.

operands.ordinary_move: The selected move is ORDINARY_PROVEN_EQUIVALENT in HnsMoveMechanicsRegistry (single-hit EFFECT_HIT, fixed power, no state-dependent flag) and has no HnsMoveItemInteractionRegistry interaction.
operands.effective_move_type: HnsMoveAuthority.effectiveType: request.moveOverride.type (pinned move + Fairy toggle) of an ordinary move, accepted only when the live attacker gimmick is observed GIMMICK_NONE, the live attacker ability is known and is not one GetDynamicMoveType reads (Normalize 96, Refrigerate 174, Pixilate 182, Aerilate 184, Liquid Voice 204, Galvanize 206), Electrify is observed false, and the observed gFieldStatuses word has no unknown bit and no Ion Deluge rewriting a Normal move. No other field bit changes an ordinary move's type, so an unrelated terrain/room/Gravity bit does not remove this authority.
operands.effective_category: HnsMoveAuthority.category: the ordinary move's pinned category under an observed PER_MOVE_SPLIT (with GIMMICK_NONE; no field bit changes it), or the category of the authoritative effective type under TYPE_BASED; unknown otherwise.
operands.wonder_room_inactive: The live gFieldStatuses word observed, fully decoded, with STATUS_FIELD_WONDER_ROOM clear.
operands.no_terrain: The live gFieldStatuses word observed, fully decoded, with every STATUS_FIELD_TERRAIN_ANY bit clear.
operands.clear_weather: The live gBattleWeather word observed exactly 0.

context_rules.predicate: The item is held by the defender.
context_rules.rationale: Every damage-path read of these hold effects is the attacker's (ctx->holdEffectAtk / holdEffectAtk / gSpecialStatuses[battlerAtk]); the defender's copy is only read when the defender itself attacks, or by Fling/Knock Off/Incinerate, which are gated separately or act after damage.

context_rules.predicate: Ordinary move whose effective category is Special.
context_rules.rationale: Choice Band, Muscle Band and Thick Club apply only when IsBattleMovePhysical(move).

context_rules.predicate: Ordinary move whose effective category is Physical.
context_rules.rationale: Choice Specs, Wise Glasses and Deep Sea Tooth apply only when IsBattleMoveSpecial(move).

context_rules.predicate: Ordinary move whose authoritative effective type differs from the item's pinned secondaryId type.
context_rules.rationale: Type boosters and Plates multiply only when moveType == GetItemSecondaryId(item); a Gem only arms gemBoost when GetBattleMoveType(move) == GetItemSecondaryId(heldItem).

context_rules.predicate: Ordinary move whose authoritative effective type is outside the item's two boosted types (Water/Dragon, Steel/Dragon, Ghost/Dragon, Psychic/Dragon).
context_rules.rationale: Each branch requires the move type to be one of its two types; Soul Dew uses the B_SOUL_DEW_BOOST >= GEN_7 type branch (GEN_LATEST), so its Sp. Def branch is inactive.

context_rules.predicate: Ordinary move whose effective category is Special.
context_rules.rationale: Wise Glasses multiplies base power by UQ4.12 4505 (1.0 + 10% floored) per pinned H&S src/battle_util.c:6818 and is modelled in the QuickJS calculator.

always_blocking.predicate: Attacker holds it and the effective category is Physical.
always_blocking.rationale: The x1.5 Attack / physical base-power modifier applies with H&S fixed-point placement the engine does not reproduce.

always_blocking.predicate: Attacker holds it and the effective category is Special.
always_blocking.rationale: The Sp. Atk / special base-power modifier applies and is not modelled.

always_blocking.predicate: Attacker holds it and the effective move type equals the item type.
always_blocking.rationale: The H&S x1.2 type boost / x1.3 gem boost applies and is not modelled.

always_blocking.predicate: Attacker holds it and the category/type condition is met.
always_blocking.rationale: The remaining condition is the holder's species, which the item context does not carry; unknown never clears.
GetAttackerItemsModifier applies Life Orb unconditionally, Metronome by consecutive-use counter, and Expert Belt on a super-effective hit whose H&S effectiveness is not proven here.
It raises the attacker's critical-hit stage; as with defender-side Battle Armor, critical odds are not part of the modelled request.
Punching Glove boosts punching moves and removes their contact; the punching flag is not part of the request.

attacker_offense.fallback: Unknown side, category, type, species or move class never clears.

context_rules.predicate: The item is held by the attacker.
context_rules.rationale: Every damage-path read of these hold effects is the defender's (ctx->holdEffectDef in CalcDefenseStat, GetDefenderItemsModifier, type effectiveness and GetAdjustedDamage). Assault Vest's other read only restricts its holder's status-move selection.

context_rules.predicate: Ordinary move whose effective category is Physical and Wonder Room is observed inactive.
context_rules.rationale: Both apply only when !usesDefStat; for an ordinary physical move usesDefStat is TRUE unless Wonder Room swaps the stats.

context_rules.predicate: Ordinary move whose effective category is Special and Wonder Room is observed inactive.
context_rules.rationale: Metal Powder applies only when usesDefStat, which is FALSE for an ordinary special move without Wonder Room.

context_rules.predicate: Ordinary move whose authoritative effective type differs from the berry's holdEffectParam type.
context_rules.rationale: The resist-berry modifier requires ctx->moveType == GetBattlerHoldEffectParam(defender); consumption happens only when it applies.
Focus Sash endures only when IsBattlerAtMaxHp(defender), i.e. hp == maxHP.

always_blocking.predicate: Defender holds it and the move uses Sp. Def.
always_blocking.rationale: The x1.5 Sp. Def modifier applies and is not modelled.

always_blocking.predicate: Defender holds it and the category condition is met.
always_blocking.rationale: The remaining condition (can-evolve state, Clamperl, untransformed Ditto) is not carried by the item context.

always_blocking.predicate: Defender holds it and the effective move type equals the berry type.
always_blocking.rationale: Whether it applies depends on H&S type effectiveness (or Normal for Chilan), which this rule does not prove.
Focus Sash can leave the defender at 1 HP; the displayed range and percentage would overstate the HP lost.
A random chance to endure at 1 HP; not modelled.
Ring Target turns a type immunity into neutral damage; the immunity is not proven absent here.

defender_defense.fallback: Unknown side, category, type, field word or HP never clears.

context_rules.predicate: The selected move is ordinary (single hit).
context_rules.rationale: These hold effects have no read in the damage computation. Every activation is an ItemBattleEffects call in a MoveEnd handler (after damage is dealt), at end of turn, at switch-in, or from an event script, so for a single-hit ordinary move none can change the hit's damage range. HP restored afterwards, contact recoil to the attacker and later stat changes are outside the displayed single-hit contract.

post_hit_or_residual.fallback: A non-ordinary or unknown move never clears.

context_rules.predicate: The selected move is ordinary and the live attacker ability is known and is not Analytic (148).
context_rules.rationale: Speed items are read by GetBattlerTotalSpeedStat and turn ordering; the damage path reads total speed only for speed-based power effects (not ordinary), orders final modifiers by the unmodified gBattleMons speed, and reads turn order only through Analytic.

always_blocking.predicate: The live attacker ability is Analytic.
always_blocking.rationale: Analytic's x1.3 depends on turn order, which the speed item can change.

turn_order.fallback: A non-ordinary move or unknown attacker ability never clears.

context_rules.rationale: Float Stone is read only by GetBattlerWeight, used by weight-based power effects, none of which is ordinary.

weight_only.fallback: A non-ordinary or unknown move never clears.

context_rules.predicate: Ordinary move, no terrain bit observed, and (Iron Ball only) the turn-order predicate holds.
context_rules.rationale: The attacker's groundedness is read only through terrain checks, which return FALSE when no terrain flag is set; Iron Ball's speed halving is covered by the turn-order predicate.

context_rules.predicate: Ordinary move, no terrain bit observed, authoritative effective type is not Ground, and (Iron Ball only) the turn-order predicate holds.
context_rules.rationale: The defender's Air Balloon / Iron Ball are read in the Ground-move effectiveness branches and in terrain checks; neither applies to a non-Ground move without terrain.

always_blocking.predicate: Defender holds it and the effective move type is Ground.
always_blocking.rationale: Air Balloon grants Ground immunity; Iron Ball lets Ground hit a Flying holder.

grounding.fallback: An active or unread terrain, an unknown field bit, unknown type or non-ordinary move never clears.

context_rules.predicate: Ordinary move and live gBattleWeather observed 0.
context_rules.rationale: Every Utility Umbrella read is conditional on sun or rain; GetWeatherDamageModifier returns 1.0 before reading it when there is no weather.

always_blocking.predicate: Live weather is sun or rain.
always_blocking.rationale: The holder ignores the weather modifier; not modelled.

weather_shield.fallback: Unobserved or non-clear weather never clears.
